FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context for section management access control, apart from tenant separation context does not affect visibility of sections - system or category context only

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Section name, it is recommended to be unique

FIELD.NAME: shortdescription
FIELD.COMMENT: Short section description text in markdown format - should not be empty

FIELD.NAME: presentationjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Visual presentation of section, such as image file info

FIELD.NAME: frontpagepriority
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL means do not show on the catalogue front page, highest priority number section/collection is displayed first on the front page

FIELD.NAME: guestvisible
FIELD.COMMENT: Are guests and not-logged-in users allowed to access the section?

FIELD.NAME: uservisible
FIELD.COMMENT: Are all users allowed to access the section? if 0 then cohort required

FIELD.NAME: hiddenfromtenants
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means section is not visible when site is switched to any tenant, 0 means section can be visible when switch to tenant depending on other restrictions

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 means draft, 1 means normal visibility logic applies, 2 means archived

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucatalog_section_cohortvisible
TABLE.COMMENT: Members of these cohorts may see section when uservisible is 0
